elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must, at Corio’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(a) specifies “a period of up to 6 months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(a) expressly applies “Commerce One’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) requires Commerce One, within 30 days after expiration or termination, to return to Corio “all Corio and Customer data.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor deletes the returned Customer Data from its systems after return.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(c) requires Commerce One to “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies the deletion to Customer after deleting the Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(c) requires Commerce One to “certify such deletion to Corio in writing.”

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must, at Corio’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The assistance is available for up to 6 months, which includes the fallback period of 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) requires Commerce One to return all Corio and Customer data to Corio within 30 days, in a standard machine-readable format.

result.reason: The added operative clause fully implements the preferred transition-assistance, data-return, deletion, and certification requirements and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It leaves the existing survival and confidentiality provisions intact and adds no unrelated commercial obligation.
